title: Korean-Italian Lechon
description: A fusion twist on traditional Italian roasted meats, incorporating the flavors of Korean BBQ and the Filipino staple, lechon.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger.
Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lechon skin on a baking sheet, leaving space for the pork shoulder.
Add the pork shoulder to the baking sheet, skin side up.
Roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for an additional 2 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with additional sauce (if desired) and steamed vegetables.
